title.zh: 卷五 本紀第五 睿宗 玄宗
title.raw: 卷五 本紀第五 睿宗 玄宗 Volume 5 Annals 5: Ruizong, Xuanzong

sentences.zh: 睿宗玄真大聖大興孝皇帝諱旦，高宗第八子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Ruizong Xuanzhen the Great Sage and Great Prospering Filial, taboo name Dan, was the eighth son of Gaozong.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ruizong, posthumously honored as Xuanzhen the Great Sage and Great Prospering Filial, bore the taboo name Dan and was the eighth son of Gaozong.

sentences.zh: 始封殷王，領冀州大都督、單于大都護。

translations.literal: At first he was enfeoffed as Prince of Yin, and held the posts of military governor-general of Jizhou and great protector of the Chanyu court.
translations.idiomatic: He was first enfeoffed as Prince of Yin and appointed military governor-general of Jizhou and great protector of the Chanyu court.

sentences.zh: 長而溫恭好學，通詁訓，工草隸書。

translations.literal: When grown he was mild, respectful, and fond of learning; he mastered glosses and exegesis and was skilled in cursive and clerical script.
translations.idiomatic: As he grew he was gentle, courteous, and devoted to study; he mastered classical glosses and was accomplished in cursive and clerical calligraphy.

sentences.zh: 徙封豫王，又封冀王，累遷右金吾衛大將軍、洛州牧。

translations.literal: His fief was changed to Prince of Yu; he was again enfeoffed as Prince of Ji, and was promoted in succession to grand general of the Right Golden Canopy Guard and prefect of Luozhou.
translations.idiomatic: His fief was changed to Prince of Yu; he was again enfeoffed as Prince of Ji and was promoted in succession to grand general of the Right Golden Canopy Guard and prefect of Luozhou.

sentences.zh: 徙封相王，復封豫王。

translations.literal: His fief was changed to Prince of Xiang, and he was again enfeoffed as Prince of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: His fief was changed to Prince of Xiang, and he was again enfeoffed as Prince of Yu.

sentences.zh: 武后廢中宗，立為皇帝，其改國號周，以為皇嗣，居于東宮。

translations.literal: Empress Wu deposed Zhongzong and established him as emperor; when she changed the dynastic title to Zhou she made him heir apparent and had him dwell in the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: When Empress Wu deposed Zhongzong she installed him as emperor; when she changed the dynastic title to Zhou she named him heir apparent and had him live in the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 中宗自房州還，復為皇太子，武后封皇嗣為相王，授太子右衛率。

translations.literal: When Zhongzong returned from Fangzhou he was again made crown prince; Empress Wu enfeoffed the heir apparent as Prince of Xiang and appointed him right commander of the Crown Prince's Guard.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhongzong returned from Fangzhou he was again made crown prince; Empress Wu enfeoffed the heir apparent as Prince of Xiang and appointed him right commander of the Crown Prince's Guard.

sentences.zh: 累遷右羽林衛大將軍、并州牧、安北大都護、諸道元帥。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to grand general of the Right Forest of Plumes Guard, prefect of Bingzhou, great protector of Andong, and commander-in-chief of all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted in succession to grand general of the Right Forest of Plumes Guard, prefect of Bingzhou, great protector of Andong, and commander-in-chief of all circuits.

sentences.zh: 中宗復位，進號安國相王。

translations.literal: When Zhongzong was restored to the throne, his title was advanced to Prince of Xiang, Protector of the State.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhongzong was restored, his title was advanced to Prince of Xiang, Protector of the State.

sentences.zh: 景雲元年六月壬午，韋皇后弒中宗，矯詔立溫王重茂為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Jingyun, on the day renwu, Empress Wei assassinated Zhongzong and forged an edict establishing Prince Wen Chongmao as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of Jingyun, on renwu, Empress Wei assassinated Zhongzong and forged an edict naming Prince Wen Chongmao crown prince.

sentences.zh: 以刑部尚書裴談、工部尚書張錫同中書門下三品；

translations.literal: Pei Tan, minister of justice, and Zhang Xi, minister of works, were made jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Pei Tan, minister of justice, and Zhang Xi, minister of works, were appointed jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank;

sentences.zh: 吏部尚書張嘉福、中書侍郎岑羲、吏部侍郎崔湜同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Zhang Jiafu, minister of the civil service; Cen Yi, vice secretary of the secretariat; and Cui Shi, vice minister of the civil service, were made Participating Secretaries jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jiafu, minister of the civil service; Cen Yi, vice secretary of the secretariat; and Cui Shi, vice minister of the civil service, were appointed Participating Secretaries jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 發諸府兵五萬屯京師，以韋溫總知內外兵馬。

translations.literal: Fifty thousand troops from the various prefectural armies were mobilized to garrison the capital, and Wei Wen was put in overall charge of internal and external military horses.
translations.idiomatic: Fifty thousand men from the prefectural armies were mobilized to camp at the capital, and Wei Wen was placed in overall command of military forces within and without the court.

sentences.zh: 甲申，乃發喪。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen the funeral procession set out.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the funeral procession set out.

sentences.zh: 又矯遺詔，自立為皇太后。

translations.literal: She again forged a posthumous edict and installed herself as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: She forged a deathbed edict as well and installed herself as empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 皇太子即皇帝位，以睿宗參謀政事，大赦，改元曰唐隆。

translations.literal: The crown prince ascended the imperial throne; Ruizong was ordered to deliberate on state affairs; a general amnesty was proclaimed and the reign title was changed to Tanglong.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince took the throne; Ruizong was ordered to deliberate on state affairs; a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name changed to Tanglong.

sentences.zh: 太后臨朝攝政，罷睿宗參謀政事，以為太尉。

translations.literal: The empress dowager held court and exercised regency; Ruizong was removed from deliberating on state affairs and appointed Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager held court as regent, removed Ruizong from deliberating on state affairs, and appointed him Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 封嗣雍王守禮為邠王，壽春郡王成器宋王。

translations.literal: Prince Shouli of Yong was enfeoffed as Prince of Bin; Chengqi, Prince of Shouchun commandery, as Prince of Song.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Shouli of Yong was enfeoffed as Prince of Bin; Chengqi, Prince of Shouchun commandery, as Prince of Song.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，溫王妃陸氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai Lady Lu of the Lu clan, consort of Prince Wen, was made empress.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Lady Lu, consort of Prince Wen, was made empress.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，紀處訥、張嘉福、岑羲持節巡撫關內、河南北。

translations.literal: On the day renchen Ji Chune, Zhang Jiafu, and Cen Yi were commissioned with staffs of authority to tour and pacify Guannei and Henan north and south.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Ji Chune, Zhang Jiafu, and Cen Yi were commissioned with plenipotentiary staffs to inspect Guannei and north and south Henan.

sentences.zh: 庚子，臨淄郡王隆基率萬騎兵入北軍討亂，誅韋氏、安樂公主及韋巨源、馬秦客、駙馬都尉武延秀、光祿少卿楊均。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi Linzi commandery prince Longji led ten thousand horsemen into the Northern Army to suppress the disorder, and executed the Wei clan, Princess Anle, Wei Juyuan, Ma Qinke, Cavalry-Commandant-in-Chief Wu Yanxiu, and Vice Minister of Court Equipage Yang Jun.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Prince Longji of Linzi commandery led ten thousand horsemen into the Northern Army to quell the uprising and executed the Wei clan, Princess Anle, Wei Juyuan, Ma Qinke, the emperor's son-in-law and commandant-in-chief of cavalry Wu Yanxiu, and Vice Minister of Court Equipage Yang Jun.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，睿宗奉皇帝御安福門，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou Ruizong escorted the emperor to the Gate of Settling Blessings and proclaimed a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Ruizong escorted the emperor to the Gate of Settling Blessings and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 賜文武官階、勳、爵，免天下歲租之半。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials were granted ranks, merit orders, and noble titles; half the year's land tax throughout the realm was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials were granted ranks, merit honors, and noble titles, and half the year's land tax throughout the realm was remitted.

sentences.zh: 進封隆基為平王。

translations.literal: Longji's fief was advanced to Prince of Ping.
translations.idiomatic: Longji was advanced in rank to Prince of Ping.

sentences.zh: 朝邑尉劉幽求為中書舍人，苑總監鍾紹京為中書侍郎，參知機務。

translations.literal: Liu Youqiu, captain of Chaoyi, was made secretariat scribe; Zhong Shaojing, director-general of the park bureau, was made vice secretary of the secretariat, to participate in knowing the machinery of state.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Youqiu, captain of Chaoyi, was appointed secretariat scribe; Zhong Shaojing, director-general of the imperial parks, was appointed vice secretary of the secretariat to participate in state affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，紹京及黃門侍郎李日知同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day renyin Shaojing and Li Rizhi, vice director of the Yellow Gate, were made jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Shaojing and Li Rizhi, vice director of the Yellow Gate, were appointed jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 紀處訥、韋溫、宗楚客、將作大匠宗晉卿、司農卿趙履溫伏誅。

translations.literal: Ji Chune, Wei Wen, Zong Chuke, Master of Works Zong Jinqing, and Minister of Agriculture Zhao Lüwen were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Chune, Wei Wen, Zong Chuke, Master of Works Zong Jinqing, and Minister of Agriculture Zhao Lüwen were put to death.

sentences.zh: 貶汴王邕為沁州刺史，蕭至忠許州刺史，韋嗣立宋州刺史，趙彥昭絳州刺史，崔湜華州刺史。

translations.literal: Prince Bian Yong was demoted to prefect of Qinzhou; Xiao Zhizhong to prefect of Xuzhou; Wei Siliz to prefect of Songzhou; Zhao Yanzhao to prefect of Jiangzhou; Cui Shi to prefect of Huazhou.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Bian Yong was demoted to prefect of Qinzhou; Xiao Zhizhong to prefect of Xuzhou; Wei Siliz to prefect of Songzhou; Zhao Yanzhao to prefect of Jiangzhou; and Cui Shi to prefect of Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On the day guimao the Metal Star was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 平王隆基同中書門下三品，鍾紹京行中書令。

translations.literal: Prince of Ping Longji was made jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank; Zhong Shaojing acted as secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Ping Longji was appointed jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank, and Zhong Shaojing acted as secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 張嘉福伏誅。

translations.literal: Zhang Jiafu was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jiafu was put to death.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，安國相王即皇帝位于承天門，大赦，長流、長任及流人未達者還之。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen the Prince of Xiang, Protector of the State, ascended the imperial throne at the Gate Accepting Heaven's Mandate; a general amnesty was proclaimed; those on long exile, long detention, and exiles who had not reached their destination were returned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the Prince of Xiang, Protector of the State, took the throne at the Gate Accepting Heaven's Mandate; a general amnesty was proclaimed; and those on long exile or long reassignment, and exiles who had not yet reached their destinations, were recalled.

sentences.zh: 賜內外官階、爵。

translations.literal: Inner and outer officials were granted ranks and noble titles.
translations.idiomatic: Officials within and without the court were granted ranks and noble titles.

sentences.zh: 復重茂為溫王。

translations.literal: Chongmao was restored as Prince of Wen.
translations.idiomatic: Chongmao was restored to the title of Prince of Wen.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，鍾紹京罷。

translations.literal: On the day yisi Zhong Shaojing was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Zhong Shaojing was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 丙午，太常少卿薛稷為黃門侍郎，參豫機務。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu Xue Ji, vice minister of rites, was made vice director of the Yellow Gate, to participate in the machinery of state.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Xue Ji, vice minister of rites, was appointed vice director of the Yellow Gate to participate in state affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁未，立平王隆基為皇太子。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei Prince of Ping Longji was established as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Prince of Ping Longji was established as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 復則天大聖皇后號曰天后。

translations.literal: Empress Zetian the Great Sage was again given the title Heavenly Empress.
translations.idiomatic: Zetian the Great Sage was again given the title of Heavenly Empress.

sentences.zh: 戊申，許州刺史姚元之為兵部尚書、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day wushen Yao Yuanzhi, prefect of Xuzhou, was made minister of war and jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Yao Yuanzhi, prefect of Xuzhou, was appointed minister of war and jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 韋嗣立、蕭至忠為中書令，趙彥昭為中書侍郎，崔湜為吏部侍郎：同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Wei Siliz and Xiao Zhizhong were made secretariat directors; Zhao Yanzhao vice secretary of the secretariat; Cui Shi vice minister of the civil service—all made Participating Secretaries jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Siliz and Xiao Zhizhong were appointed secretariat directors; Zhao Yanzhao vice secretary of the secretariat; and Cui Shi vice minister of the civil service—all as Participating Secretaries jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 七月庚戌，進封衡陽郡王成義為申王，巴陵郡王隆範岐王，彭城郡王隆業薛王。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day gengxu Cheng Yi, Prince of Hengyang commandery, was advanced in enfeoffment to Prince of Shen; Longfan of Baling commandery to Prince of Qi; Longye of Pengcheng commandery to Prince of Xue.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on gengxu Cheng Yi, Prince of Hengyang commandery, was advanced to Prince of Shen; Longfan of Baling commandery to Prince of Qi; and Longye of Pengcheng commandery to Prince of Xue.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，兵部尚書崔日用為黃門侍郎，參豫機務。

translations.literal: On the day guichou Cui Riyong, minister of war, was made vice director of the Yellow Gate, to participate in the machinery of state.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Cui Riyong, minister of war, was appointed vice director of the Yellow Gate to participate in state affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，洛州長史宋璟檢校吏部尚書、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi Song Jing, chief administrator of Luozhou, was made acting minister of the civil service and jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Song Jing, chief administrator of Luozhou, was appointed acting minister of the civil service and jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 岑羲罷。

translations.literal: Cen Yi was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Cen Yi was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，貶蕭至忠為晉州刺史，韋嗣立許州刺史，趙彥昭宋州刺史，張錫絳州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day renxu Xiao Zhizhong was demoted to prefect of Jinzhou; Wei Siliz to prefect of Xuzhou; Zhao Yanzhao to prefect of Songzhou; Zhang Xi to prefect of Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Xiao Zhizhong was demoted to prefect of Jinzhou; Wei Siliz to prefect of Xuzhou; Zhao Yanzhao to prefect of Songzhou; and Zhang Xi to prefect of Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 崔湜罷。

translations.literal: Cui Shi was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Shi was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，貶李嶠為懷州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin Li Jiao was demoted to prefect of Huaizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Li Jiao was demoted to prefect of Huaizhou.

sentences.zh: 姚元之兼中書令，蘇瓌為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: Yao Yuanzhi was additionally made secretariat director; Su Wei was made left vice director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Yuanzhi was additionally appointed secretariat director, and Su Wei was appointed left vice director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，唐休璟、張仁亶罷。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao Tang Xiujing and Zhang Renyuan were dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Tang Xiujing and Zhang Renyuan were removed from office.

sentences.zh: 己巳，大赦，改元，賜內外官及子為父後者勳一轉。

translations.literal: On the day jisi a general amnesty was proclaimed, the reign title was changed, and inner and outer officials and sons who were heirs for their fathers were granted one step in merit order.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi a general amnesty was proclaimed, the era name was changed, and officials within and without the court and sons serving as heirs for their fathers were granted one merit grade.

sentences.zh: 崔日用、薛稷罷。

translations.literal: Cui Riyong and Xue Ji were dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Riyong and Xue Ji were removed from office.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，廢崇恩廟、昊陵、順陵。

translations.literal: On the day yihai the Temple of Revering Grace, Maoling, and Shunling were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the Temple of Revering Grace, Maoling, and Shunling were abolished.

sentences.zh: 追廢皇后韋氏為庶人，安樂公主為勃逆庶人。

translations.literal: Empress Wei was posthumously deposed and reduced to commoner status; Princess Anle was reduced to treacherous and rebellious commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Wei was posthumously deposed as a commoner; Princess Anle was posthumously degraded to treacherous rebel commoner.

sentences.zh: 八月庚寅，譙王重福及汴州刺史鄭愔反，伏誅。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day gengyin Prince Qiao Chongfu and Zheng Yin, prefect of Bianzhou, rebelled and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on gengyin Prince Qiao Chongfu and Zheng Yin, prefect of Bianzhou, rebelled and were put to death.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，罷墨敕斜封官。

translations.literal: On the day guisi unofficial appointments by black edict and sideway sealing were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi appointments by informal edict and “sideway seal” patronage were abolished.

sentences.zh: 貶裴談為蒲州刺史。

translations.literal: Pei Tan was demoted to prefect of Puzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Tan was demoted to prefect of Puzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月辛未，太子少師致仕唐休璟為朔方道行軍大總管，以備突厥。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day xinwei Tang Xiujing, retired grand master of the crown prince's household, was made mobile grand commander of the Shuofang circuit to guard against the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on xinwei Tang Xiujing, retired grand tutor of the crown prince, was appointed mobile grand commander on the Shuofang circuit to guard against the Turks.

sentences.zh: 十月乙未，追號天后曰大聖天后。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day yiwei the Heavenly Empress was posthumously given the title Great Sage Heavenly Empress.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on yiwei the Heavenly Empress was posthumously titled Great Sage Heavenly Empress.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，出義宗于太廟。

translations.literal: On the day guimao Yizong was removed from the imperial temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Yizong was removed from the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊申，姚元之為中書令。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day wushen Yao Yuanzhi was made secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on wushen Yao Yuanzhi was appointed secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 己酉，葬孝和皇帝于定陵。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou the Filial and Harmonious Emperor was buried at Dingling.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the Filial and Harmonious Emperor was buried at Dingling.

sentences.zh: 壬子，蘇瓌、韋安石罷。

translations.literal: On the day renzi Su Wei and Wei Anshi were dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Su Wei and Wei Anshi were removed from office.

sentences.zh: 宋王成器為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: Chengqi, Prince of Song, was made left vice director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Chengqi, Prince of Song, was appointed left vice director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，赦靈駕所過。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao amnesty was proclaimed along the route of the imperial spirit carriage.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao amnesty was granted along the route of the funeral procession.

sentences.zh: 己巳，宋王成器為司徒。

translations.literal: On the day jisi Chengqi, Prince of Song, was made Grand Mentor of State.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Chengqi, Prince of Song, was appointed Grand Mentor of State.

sentences.zh: 二年正月己未，太僕卿郭元振、中書侍郎張說同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year on the day jiwei Guo Yuanzhen, minister of the palace stud, and Zhang Yue, vice secretary of the secretariat, were made Participating Secretaries jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year on jiwei Guo Yuanzhen, minister of the palace stud, and Zhang Yue, vice secretary of the secretariat, were appointed Participating Secretaries jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 甲子，徙封重茂為襄王。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi Chongmao's fief was changed to Prince of Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Chongmao was transferred and enfeoffed as Prince of Xiang.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，追冊妃劉氏、竇氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On the day yichou Consort Liu and Consort Dou were posthumously enregistered as empresses.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Consorts Liu and Dou were posthumously enregistered as empresses.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，皇太子監國。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day dingchou the crown prince supervised the state.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on dingchou the crown prince supervised the state.

sentences.zh: 甲申，貶姚元之為申州刺史，宋璟楚州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen Yao Yuanzhi was demoted to prefect of Shenzhou; Song Jing to prefect of Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Yao Yuanzhi was demoted to prefect of Shenzhou and Song Jing to prefect of Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，太子少保韋安石為侍中。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu Wei Anshi, junior mentor of the crown prince, was made palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Wei Anshi, junior protector of the crown prince, was appointed palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 劉幽求罷。

translations.literal: Liu Youqiu was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Youqiu was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 復墨敕斜封官。

translations.literal: Unofficial appointments by black edict and sideway sealing were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Appointments by informal edict and sideway-seal patronage were restored.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，禁屠。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao slaughter was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao slaughtering animals was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 三月癸丑，作金仙、玉真觀。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day guichou the Golden Immortal and Jade Perfection abbeys were built.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on guichou the Golden Immortal and Jade Perfection Daoist abbeys were built.

sentences.zh: 四月甲申，韋安石為中書令。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day jiashen Wei Anshi was made secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on jiashen Wei Anshi was appointed secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 宋王成器罷。

translations.literal: Chengqi, Prince of Song, was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Chengqi, Prince of Song, was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，李日知為侍中。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao Li Rizhi was made palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Li Rizhi was appointed palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，大赦，賜文武官階、勳、爵，民酺三日。

translations.literal: On the day renyin a general amnesty was proclaimed; civil and military officials were granted ranks, merit orders, and noble titles; the common people were granted three days of communal drinking.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin a general amnesty was proclaimed; civil and military officials were granted ranks, merit honors, and titles; and the people were granted three days of communal feasting.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，作玄元皇帝廟。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen the temple of the Mysterious Origin Emperor was built.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen a temple to the Mysterious Origin Emperor was built.

sentences.zh: 五月庚戌，復昊陵、順陵，置官屬。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day gengxu Maoling and Shunling were restored and official staffs were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on gengxu Maoling and Shunling were restored and official staffs appointed.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，殿中監竇懷貞為左御史臺大夫、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day renxu Dou Huaizhen, superintendent of the palace bureau, was made left censor-in-chief and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Dou Huaizhen, superintendent of the palace bureau, was appointed left censor-in-chief and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 八月乙卯，大赦，賜酺三日。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day yimao a general amnesty was proclaimed and three days of communal drinking were granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on yimao a general amnesty was proclaimed and three days of communal feasting were granted.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，皇太子釋奠于國學。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi the crown prince performed the libation sacrifice at the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the crown prince performed the libation sacrifice at the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 庚午，韋安石為尚書左僕射、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu Wei Anshi was made left vice director of the Department of State Affairs and jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Wei Anshi was appointed left vice director of the Department of State Affairs and jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 九月乙亥，竇懷貞為侍中。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day yihai Dou Huaizhen was made palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on yihai Dou Huaizhen was appointed palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 十月甲辰，吏部尚書劉幽求為侍中，右散騎常侍魏知古，太子詹事崔湜為中書侍郎：同中書門下三品；

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day jiachen Liu Youqiu, minister of the civil service, was made palace attendant; Wei Zhigu, right attendant-in-ordinary; and Cui Shi, grand steward of the crown prince, were made vice secretary of the secretariat—all jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank;
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on jiachen Liu Youqiu, minister of the civil service, was appointed palace attendant; Wei Zhigu, right attendant-in-ordinary; and Cui Shi, grand steward of the crown prince, were appointed vice secretaries of the secretariat—all jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank;

sentences.zh: 中書侍郎陸象先同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Lu Xiangxian, vice secretary of the secretariat, was made Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Xiangxian, vice secretary of the secretariat, was appointed Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 韋安石、李日知、郭元振、竇懷貞、張說罷。

translations.literal: Wei Anshi, Li Rizhi, Guo Yuanzhen, Dou Huaizhen, and Zhang Yue were dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Anshi, Li Rizhi, Guo Yuanzhen, Dou Huaizhen, and Zhang Yue were removed from office.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁未，作潑寒胡戲。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day dingwei the “Splash Cold Barbarian” performance was staged.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on dingwei the Splash-the-Cold-Barbarian pageant was staged.

sentences.zh: 先天元年正月辛未，享于太廟。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Xiantian, on the day xinwei, sacrifice was offered at the imperial temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Xiantian, on xinwei, the court sacrificed at the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，并、汾、絳三州地震。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu the three prefectures of Bing, Fen, and Jiang were struck by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu earthquakes struck the three prefectures of Bing, Fen, and Jiang.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，有事于南郊。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi the southern suburb rites were performed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the southern suburb rites were performed.

sentences.zh: 戊子，耕籍田。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi the emperor plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the emperor plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 己丑，大赦，改元曰太極。

translations.literal: On the day jichou a general amnesty was proclaimed and the reign title was changed to Taiji.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name changed to Taiji.

sentences.zh: 賜內外官階、爵，民酺五日。

translations.literal: Inner and outer officials were granted ranks and noble titles; the common people were granted five days of communal drinking.
translations.idiomatic: Officials within and without the court were granted ranks and titles, and the people were granted five days of communal feasting.

sentences.zh: 版授九十以上下州刺史，八十以上上州司馬。

translations.literal: Those over ninety were appointed by patent to prefects of lower prefectures; those over eighty, to military commissioners of upper prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Those aged ninety and above were granted patents as prefects of lower prefectures; those eighty and above, as military commissioners of upper prefectures.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，幸安福門，觀酺三日夜。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao the emperor visited the Gate of Settling Blessings and watched three nights of communal drinking.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the emperor visited the Gate of Settling Blessings and watched three nights of communal feasting.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，陸象先同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day renchen Lu Xiangxian was made jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Lu Xiangxian was appointed jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 乙未，戶部尚書岑羲、左御史臺大夫竇懷貞同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei Cen Yi, minister of revenue, and Dou Huaizhen, left censor-in-chief, were made jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Cen Yi, minister of revenue, and Dou Huaizhen, left censor-in-chief, were appointed jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 二月丁巳，皇太子釋奠于國學。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day dingsi the crown prince performed the libation sacrifice at the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on dingsi the crown prince performed the libation sacrifice at the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 是春，旱。

translations.literal: That spring there was drought.
translations.idiomatic: That spring brought drought.

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅，有事于北郊。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day wuyin the northern suburb rites were performed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on wuyin the northern suburb rites were performed.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，大赦，改元曰延和。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi a general amnesty was proclaimed and the reign title was changed to Yanhe.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name changed to Yanhe.

sentences.zh: 賜內外官陪禮者勳一轉，民酺五日。

translations.literal: Inner and outer officials who attended the rites were granted one step in merit order; the common people were granted five days of communal drinking.
translations.idiomatic: Officials within and without the court who attended the rites were granted one merit grade, and the people were granted five days of communal feasting.

sentences.zh: 六月癸丑，岑羲為侍中。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day guichou Cen Yi was made palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on guichou Cen Yi was appointed palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，追號大聖天后為天后聖帝。

translations.literal: On the day yimao the Great Sage Heavenly Empress was posthumously given the title Heavenly Empress Sage Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the Great Sage Heavenly Empress was posthumously titled Heavenly Empress Sage Emperor.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，刑部尚書郭元振為朔方道行軍大總管，以伐突厥。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou Guo Yuanzhen, minister of justice, was made mobile grand commander of the Shuofang circuit to attack the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Guo Yuanzhen, minister of justice, was appointed mobile grand commander on the Shuofang circuit to attack the Turks.

sentences.zh: 甲子，幽州都督孫佺、左驍衛將軍李楷洛、左威衛將軍周以悌及奚戰于冷陘山，敗績。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi Sun Quan, military governor of Youzhou; Li Kailuo, general of the Left Martial Cavalry Guard; Zhou Yiti, general of the Left Martial Might Guard; and the Xi fought at Cold Pass Mountain and were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Sun Quan, military governor of Youzhou; Li Kailuo, general of the Left Martial Cavalry Guard; Zhou Yiti, general of the Left Martial Might Guard; and the Xi fought at Cold Pass Mountain and suffered defeat.

sentences.zh: 七月辛未，有彗星入于太微。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day xinwei a comet entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on xinwei a comet entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書李迥秀為朔方道後軍大總管。

translations.literal: Li Jiongxiu, minister of war, was made rear-army grand commander of the Shuofang circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jiongxiu, minister of war, was appointed rear-army grand commander on the Shuofang circuit.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，竇懷貞為尚書右僕射、平章軍國重事。

translations.literal: On the day yihai Dou Huaizhen was made right vice director of the Department of State Affairs and Participating Secretary for weighty affairs of state and army.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Dou Huaizhen was appointed right vice director of the Department of State Affairs and Participating Secretary for weighty affairs of state and army.

sentences.zh: 己卯，幸安福門觀樂，三日而止。

translations.literal: On the day jimao the emperor visited the Gate of Settling Blessings to watch music; it ceased after three days.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the emperor visited the Gate of Settling Blessings to watch performances, which ended after three days.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以旱減膳。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu meals were reduced because of drought.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu court meals were reduced because of drought.

sentences.zh: 八月庚子，立皇太子為皇帝，以聽小事；

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day gengzi the crown prince was established as emperor to hear minor affairs;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on gengzi the crown prince was installed as emperor to hear minor affairs;

sentences.zh: 自尊為太上皇，以聽大事。

translations.literal: He took for himself the title of retired emperor to hear major affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Ruizong took the title of Retired Emperor to hear major affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，追號天后聖帝為聖后。

translations.literal: On the day renyin the Heavenly Empress Sage Emperor was posthumously given the title Sage Empress.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the Heavenly Empress Sage Emperor was posthumously titled Sage Empress.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，大赦，改元，賜內外官及五品以上子為父後者勳、爵，民酺五日。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen a general amnesty was proclaimed, the reign title was changed, inner and outer officials and sons of fifth rank and above who were heirs for their fathers were granted merit orders and noble titles, and the common people were granted five days of communal drinking.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen a general amnesty was proclaimed, the era name was changed, officials within and without the court and sons of fifth rank and above serving as heirs for their fathers were granted merit honors and titles, and the people were granted five days of communal feasting.

sentences.zh: 丁未，立皇太子妃王氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei the crown prince's consort Lady Wang was established as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the crown prince's consort Lady Wang was established as empress.

sentences.zh: 戊申，封皇帝子嗣直為郯王，嗣謙郢王。

translations.literal: On the day wushen the emperor's son Sizhi was enfeoffed as Prince of Tan, and Siqian as Prince of Ying.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the emperor's son Sizhi was enfeoffed as Prince of Tan and Siqian as Prince of Ying.

sentences.zh: 己酉，宋王成器為司徒。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou Chengqi, Prince of Song, was made Grand Mentor of State.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Chengqi, Prince of Song, was appointed Grand Mentor of State.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，竇懷貞為尚書左僕射，劉幽求守尚書右僕射：同中書門下三品；

translations.literal: On the day gengxu Dou Huaizhen was made left vice director of the Department of State Affairs, and Liu Youqiu acting right vice director—all jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank;
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Dou Huaizhen was appointed left vice director of the Department of State Affairs and Liu Youqiu acting right vice director—all jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank;

sentences.zh: 魏知古為侍中，崔湜檢校中書令。

translations.literal: Wei Zhigu was made palace attendant, and Cui Shi acting secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zhigu was appointed palace attendant and Cui Shi acting secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 戊午，流劉幽求于封州。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu Liu Youqiu was exiled to Fengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Liu Youqiu was exiled to Fengzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月丁卯朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day dingmao of the ninth month there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the ninth month, dingmao, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 甲午，封皇帝子嗣昇為陝王。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu the emperor's son Sisheng was enfeoffed as Prince of Shan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the emperor's son Sisheng was enfeoffed as Prince of Shan.

sentences.zh: 十月辛卯，獵于驪山。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day xinmao the emperor hunted at Mount Li.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on xinmao the emperor hunted at Mount Li.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁亥，誥遣皇帝巡邊。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day dinghai an imperial proclamation dispatched the emperor to tour the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on dinghai an imperial proclamation dispatched the emperor to tour the frontier.

sentences.zh: 甲午，幽州都督宋璟為左軍大總管，并州長史薛訥為中軍大總管，兵部尚書郭元振為右軍大總管。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu Song Jing, military governor of Youzhou, was made left-army grand commander; Xue Ne, chief administrator of Bingzhou, middle-army grand commander; and Guo Yuanzhen, minister of war, right-army grand commander.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Song Jing, military governor of Youzhou, was appointed left-army grand commander; Xue Ne, chief administrator of Bingzhou, middle-army grand commander; and Guo Yuanzhen, minister of war, right-army grand commander.

sentences.zh: 二年正月乙亥，吏部尚書蕭至忠為中書令。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year on the day yihai Xiao Zhizhong, minister of the civil service, was made secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year on yihai Xiao Zhizhong, minister of the civil service, was appointed secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 二月，追作先天元年酺。

translations.literal: In the second month communal drinking for the first year of Xiantian was held retrospectively.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the court held the communal feasting for the first year of Xiantian retrospectively.

sentences.zh: 六月辛丑，以雨霖避正殿，減膳。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day xinchou, because of continuous rain, the emperor avoided the main hall and reduced meals.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on xinchou, because of continuous rain, the emperor avoided the main hall and reduced court meals.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，郭元振同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen Guo Yuanzhen was made jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Guo Yuanzhen was appointed jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 七月甲子，大赦。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day jiazi a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on jiazi a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，誥歸政于皇帝。

translations.literal: On the day yichou an imperial proclamation returned government to the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou an imperial proclamation returned government to the emperor.

sentences.zh: 開元四年六月，崩于百福殿，年五十五，謚曰大聖真皇帝。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fourth year of Kaiyuan he died in the Hall of Hundred Blessings at age fifty-five; his posthumous title was Great Sage True Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fourth year of Kaiyuan he died in the Hall of Hundred Blessings at age fifty-five; his posthumous title was Great Sage True Emperor.

sentences.zh: 天寶十三載，增謚玄真大聖大興孝皇帝。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Tianbao his posthumous title was augmented to Xuanzhen the Great Sage and Great Prospering Filial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Tianbao his posthumous title was augmented to Xuanzhen the Great Sage and Great Prospering Filial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 玄宗至道大聖大明孝皇帝諱隆基，睿宗第三子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong Zhidao the Great Sage Great Bright Filial, taboo name Longji, was the third son of Ruizong.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong, posthumously honored as Zhidao the Great Sage and Great Brightly Filial, bore the taboo name Longji and was the third son of Ruizong.

sentences.zh: 母曰昭成皇后竇氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Zhaocheng of the Dou clan.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Zhaocheng of the Dou clan.

sentences.zh: 性英武，善騎射，通音律、曆象之學。

translations.literal: By nature he was heroic and martial, skilled at riding and archery, and versed in music, calendrical astronomy, and portents.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was bold and martial, skilled at riding and archery, and versed in music, calendrical astronomy, and portents.

sentences.zh: 始封楚王，後為臨淄郡王。

translations.literal: At first he was enfeoffed as Prince of Chu, and later became Prince of Linzi commandery.
translations.idiomatic: He was first enfeoffed as Prince of Chu and later became Prince of Linzi commandery.

sentences.zh: 累遷衛尉少卿、潞州別駕。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to vice minister of the court of imperial stud and vice prefect of Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted in succession to vice minister of the court of imperial stud and vice prefect of Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 景龍四年

translations.literal: The fourth year of Jinglong
translations.idiomatic: The fourth year of Jinglong

sentences.zh: 景龍四年，朝于京師，遂留不遣。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jinglong he attended court at the capital and was then detained and not sent back.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Jinglong he attended court at the capital and was then detained and not sent back.

sentences.zh: 庶人韋氏已弒中宗，矯詔稱制。

translations.literal: The commoner Wei clan had already assassinated Zhongzong and forged an edict to exercise imperial authority.
translations.idiomatic: The deposed Wei clan had already assassinated Zhongzong and forged an edict to rule in the emperor's name.

sentences.zh: 玄宗乃與太平公主子薛崇簡、尚衣奉御王崇曄、公主府典籤王師虔、朝邑尉劉幽求、苑總監鍾紹京、長上折衝麻嗣宗、押萬騎果毅葛福順李仙鳧、道士馮處澄、僧普潤定策討亂。

translations.literal: Xuanzong then joined with Princess Taiping's son Xue Chongjian, Palace Wardrobe Attendant Wang Chongye, the princess household registrar Wang Shiqian, Chaoyi captain Liu Youqiu, park director-general Zhong Shaojing, senior commander Ma Sizong, commanders of the Ten Thousand Cavalry Guo Fushun and Li Xianfeng, the Daoist Feng Chucheng, and the monk Puyun to settle a plan to suppress the disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong then joined Princess Taiping's son Xue Chongjian, Palace Wardrobe Attendant Wang Chongye, the princess household registrar Wang Shiqian, Chaoyi captain Liu Youqiu, park director-general Zhong Shaojing, senior commander Ma Sizong, commanders of the Ten Thousand Cavalry Guo Fushun and Li Xianfeng, the Daoist Feng Chucheng, and the monk Puyun to settle on a plan to suppress the uprising.

sentences.zh: 或請先啟相王，玄宗曰：「請而從，是王與危事；

translations.literal: Some urged informing the Prince of Xiang first; Xuanzong said, "If one asks and he agrees, the prince is joined to a perilous affair;
translations.idiomatic: Some urged informing Prince Xiang first; Xuanzong said, "If we ask and he agrees, the prince is tied to a dangerous affair;

sentences.zh: 不從，則吾計失矣。

translations.literal: if he does not agree, then my plan is lost."
translations.idiomatic: if he refuses, my plan is ruined."

sentences.zh: 」乃夜率幽求等入苑中，福順、仙鳧以萬騎兵攻玄武門，斬左羽林將軍韋播、中郎將高嵩以徇。

translations.literal: " That night he led Youqiu and the others into the park; Fushun and Xianfeng with ten thousand horsemen attacked the Xuanwu Gate and beheaded Left Forest of Plumes general Wei Bo and commandant Gao Song as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: " That night he led Youqiu and the others into the imperial park; Fushun and Xianfeng attacked the Xuanwu Gate with ten thousand horsemen and beheaded Left Forest of Plumes general Wei Bo and commandant Gao Song as a warning.

sentences.zh: 左萬騎由左入，右萬騎由右入，玄宗率總監羽林兵會兩儀殿，梓宮宿衛兵皆起應之，遂誅韋氏。

translations.literal: The left Ten Thousand Cavalry entered from the left, the right from the right; Xuanzong led the director-general's Forest of Plumes troops to meet at the Hall of Two Rites; the guards of the imperial coffin all rose in response, and the Wei clan was then executed.
translations.idiomatic: The left Ten Thousand Cavalry entered from the left and the right from the right; Xuanzong led the director-general's Forest of Plumes troops to the Hall of Two Rites; the guards of the imperial coffin all rose in response, and the Wei clan was executed.

sentences.zh: 黎明，馳謁相王，謝不先啟。

translations.literal: At dawn he galloped to visit the Prince of Xiang and apologized for not informing him first.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn he galloped to visit Prince Xiang and apologized for not informing him first.

sentences.zh: 相王泣曰：「賴汝以免，不然，吾且及難。

translations.literal: The Prince of Xiang wept and said, "It is thanks to you that I escaped; otherwise I would soon have met disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Xiang wept and said, "Thanks to you I escaped; otherwise I would soon have come to harm.

sentences.zh: 」乃拜玄宗殿中監，兼知內外閑廄、檢校隴右羣牧大使，押左右萬騎，進封平王，同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: " Xuanzong was then appointed palace director, additionally charged with internal and external stud stables, acting commissioner of the Longyou herd office, commander of the left and right Ten Thousand Cavalry, advanced in enfeoffment to Prince of Ping, and made jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: " Xuanzong was then appointed palace director, additionally charged with internal and external stud stables, acting commissioner of the Longyou herd office, commander of the left and right Ten Thousand Cavalry, advanced to Prince of Ping, and appointed jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 景雲二年

translations.literal: The second year of Jingyun
translations.idiomatic: The second year of Jingyun

sentences.zh: 睿宗即位，立為皇太子。

translations.literal: When Ruizong took the throne, he was established as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: When Ruizong took the throne, he was established as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 景雲二年，監國，聽除六品以下官。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jingyun he supervised the state and was authorized to appoint and remove officials of the sixth rank and below.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jingyun he supervised the state and was authorized to appoint and remove officials of the sixth rank and below.

sentences.zh: 延和元年

translations.literal: The first year of Yanhe
translations.idiomatic: The first year of Yanhe

sentences.zh: 延和元年，星官言：「帝坐前星有變。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yanhe the court astronomer said, "The star before the Imperial Seat has changed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yanhe the court astronomer said, "The star before the Imperial Seat has changed.

sentences.zh: 」睿宗曰：「傳德避災，吾意決矣。

translations.literal: " Ruizong said, "To transmit virtue and avoid calamity—my mind is decided.
translations.idiomatic: " Ruizong said, "To transmit virtue and avoid calamity—my mind is made up.

sentences.zh: 」七月壬辰，制皇太子宜即皇帝位。

translations.literal: " In the seventh month on the day renchen an edict declared that the crown prince should immediately take the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: " In the seventh month on renchen an edict declared that the crown prince should immediately take the imperial throne.

sentences.zh: 太子惶懼入請，睿宗曰「此吾所以荅天戒也。

translations.literal: The crown prince entered in fear to plead; Ruizong said, "This is how I answer Heaven's warning.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince entered in fear to plead; Ruizong said, "This is how I answer Heaven's warning.

sentences.zh: 」皇太子乃御武德殿，除三品以下官。

translations.literal: " The crown prince then held court at Wude Hall and appointed and removed officials of the third rank and below.
translations.idiomatic: " The crown prince then held court at Wude Hall and appointed and removed officials of the third rank and below.

sentences.zh: 八月庚子，即皇帝位。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day gengzi he ascended the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on gengzi he ascended the imperial throne.

sentences.zh: 先天元年

translations.literal: The first year of Xiantian
translations.idiomatic: The first year of Xiantian

sentences.zh: 先天元年十月庚子，享于太廟，大赦。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the first year of Xiantian, on the day gengzi, sacrifice was offered at the imperial temple and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the first year of Xiantian, on gengzi, the court sacrificed at the ancestral temple and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 開元元年

translations.literal: The first year of Kaiyuan
translations.idiomatic: The first year of Kaiyuan

sentences.zh: 開元元年正月辛巳，皇后親蠶。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Kaiyuan, on the day xinsi, the empress personally performed the silkworm rite.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Kaiyuan, on xinsi, the empress personally performed the silkworm rite.

sentences.zh: 七月甲子，太平公主及岑羲、蕭至忠、竇懷貞謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day jiazi Princess Taiping and Cen Yi, Xiao Zhizhong, and Dou Huaizhen plotted rebellion and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on jiazi Princess Taiping and Cen Yi, Xiao Zhizhong, and Dou Huaizhen plotted rebellion and were put to death.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，始聽政。

translations.literal: On the day yichou he began to hear government affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he began to hear government affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，大赦，賜文武官階、爵。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao a general amnesty was proclaimed and civil and military officials were granted ranks and noble titles.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao a general amnesty was proclaimed and civil and military officials were granted ranks and titles.

sentences.zh: 庚午，流崔湜于竇州。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu Cui Shi was exiled to Douzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Cui Shi was exiled to Douzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，毀天樞。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu the Heavenly Pillar was destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the Heavenly Pillar was destroyed.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，尚書右丞張說檢校中書令。

translations.literal: On the day yihai Zhang Yue, right vice director of the Department of State Affairs, was made acting secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Zhang Yue, right vice director of the Department of State Affairs, was appointed acting secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，陸象先罷。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen Lu Xiangxian was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Lu Xiangxian was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 八月癸巳，劉幽求為尚書右僕射，知軍國大事。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day guisi Liu Youqiu was made right vice director of the Department of State Affairs and charged with weighty affairs of state and army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on guisi Liu Youqiu was appointed right vice director of the Department of State Affairs and charged with weighty affairs of state and army.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，宋王成器為太尉，申王成義為司徒，邠王守禮為司空。

translations.literal: On the day renyin Chengqi, Prince of Song, was made Grand Commandant; Chengyi, Prince of Shen, Grand Mentor of State; and Shouli, Prince of Bin, Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Chengqi, Prince of Song, was appointed Grand Commandant; Chengyi, Prince of Shen, Grand Mentor of State; and Shouli, Prince of Bin, Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 九月丙寅，宋王成器罷。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day bingyin Chengqi, Prince of Song, was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on bingyin Chengqi, Prince of Song, was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 庚午，劉幽求同中書門下三品，張說為中書令。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu Liu Youqiu was made jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank, and Zhang Yue secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Liu Youqiu was appointed jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank and Zhang Yue secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 十月，姚巂蠻寇姚州，都督李蒙死之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month the Yao-Xi barbarians raided Yaozhou and military governor Li Meng died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the Yao-Xi barbarians raided Yaozhou and military governor Li Meng was killed.

sentences.zh: 己亥，幸溫湯。

translations.literal: On the day jihai the emperor visited the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the emperor visited the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，講武于驪山。

translations.literal: On the day guimao military exercises were conducted at Mount Li.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao military exercises were conducted at Mount Li.

sentences.zh: 流郭元振于新州，給事中唐紹伏誅。

translations.literal: Guo Yuanzhen was exiled to Xinzhou, and Supervising Secretary Tang Shao was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Yuanzhen was exiled to Xinzhou and Supervising Secretary Tang Shao was put to death.

sentences.zh: 免新豐來歲稅，賜從官帛。

translations.literal: The next year's tax of Xinfeng was remitted and silk was granted to attending officials.
translations.idiomatic: Xinfeng's tax for the coming year was remitted and silk was granted to officials in attendance.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，獵于渭川。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen the emperor hunted on the Wei River.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the emperor hunted on the Wei River.

sentences.zh: 同州刺史姚元之為兵部尚書、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Yao Yuanzhi, prefect of Tongzhou, was made minister of war and jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Yuanzhi, prefect of Tongzhou, was appointed minister of war and jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，至自渭川。

translations.literal: On the day yisi he returned from the Wei River.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he returned from the Wei River.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙丑，劉幽求兼侍中。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day yichou Liu Youqiu was additionally made palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on yichou Liu Youqiu was additionally appointed palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 戊子，羣臣上尊號曰開元神武皇帝。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi the multitude of officials presented the honorific title Kaiyuan Divine Martial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the officials presented the honorific title Kaiyuan Divine Martial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚寅，大赦，改元，賜內外官勳。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day gengyin a general amnesty was proclaimed, the reign title was changed, and inner and outer officials were granted merit orders.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on gengyin a general amnesty was proclaimed, the era name was changed, and officials within and without the court were granted merit honors.

sentences.zh: 改中書省為紫微省，門下省為黃門省，侍中為監。

translations.literal: The Secretariat was renamed the Purple Micro Bureau, the Chancellery the Yellow Gate Bureau, and the palace attendant the Supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat was renamed the Purple Micro Bureau, the Chancellery the Yellow Gate Bureau, and the palace attendant the Supervisor.

sentences.zh: 甲午，吐蕃請和。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu Tibet requested peace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Tibet requested peace.

sentences.zh: 己亥，禁潑寒胡戲。

translations.literal: On the day jihai the Splash-the-Cold-Barbarian performance was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the Splash-the-Cold-Barbarian pageant was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，姚崇兼紫微令。

translations.literal: On the day renyin Yao Chong was additionally made Purple Micro Director.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Yao Chong was additionally appointed Purple Micro Director.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，劉幽求罷。

translations.literal: On the day guichou Liu Youqiu was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Liu Youqiu was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 貶張說為相州刺史。

translations.literal: Zhang Yue was demoted to prefect of Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yue was demoted to prefect of Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，黃門侍郎盧懷慎同紫微黃門平章事。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin Lu Huaishen, vice director of the Yellow Gate, was made Participating Secretary jointly with the Purple Micro and Yellow Gate bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Lu Huaishen, vice director of the Yellow Gate, was appointed Participating Secretary jointly with the Purple Micro and Yellow Gate bureaus.

sentences.zh: 二年正月壬午，以關內旱，求直諫，停不急之務，寬繫囚，祠名山大川，葬暴骸。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year on the day renwu, because of drought within the passes, straight remonstrance was sought, nonurgent affairs were halted, imprisoned persons were leniently treated, famous mountains and great rivers were sacrificed to, and exposed corpses were buried.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year on renwu, because of drought within the passes, the court sought frank remonstrance, halted nonurgent affairs, leniently treated prisoners, sacrificed to famous mountains and great rivers, and buried exposed corpses.

sentences.zh: 甲申，并州節度大使薛訥同紫微黃門三品，以伐契丹。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen Xue Ne, frontier commissioner of Bingzhou, was made jointly with the Purple Micro and Yellow Gate bureaus as Third Rank to attack the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Xue Ne, frontier commissioner of Bingzhou, was appointed jointly with the Purple Micro and Yellow Gate bureaus as Third Rank to attack the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 二月壬辰，避正殿，減膳，徹樂。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day renchen the emperor avoided the main hall, reduced meals, and removed music.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on renchen the emperor avoided the main hall, reduced court meals, and removed music.

sentences.zh: 突厥寇北庭，都護郭虔瓘敗之。

translations.literal: The Turks raided Beiting and Protector Guo Qianjin defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: The Turks raided Beiting and Protector Guo Qianjin defeated them.

sentences.zh: 己酉，慮囚。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the court reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 三月己亥，磧西節度使阿史那獻執西突厥都擔。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day jihai Ashina Xian, commissioner of the Western Frontier circuit, captured Dutan, chief of the Western Turks.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on jihai Ashina Xian, commissioner of the Western Frontier circuit, captured Dutan, chief of the Western Turks.

sentences.zh: 四月辛未，停諸陵供奉鷹犬。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day xinwei offerings of hawks and dogs at the imperial tombs were halted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on xinwei offerings of hawks and dogs at the imperial tombs were halted.

sentences.zh: 五月辛亥，魏知古罷。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day xinhai Wei Zhigu was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on xinhai Wei Zhigu was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 六月，京師大風拔木。

translations.literal: In the sixth month a great wind in the capital uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month a great wind in the capital uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以太上皇避暑，徙御大明宮。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, because the retired emperor sought cool weather, the court moved to the Great Bright Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, because the Retired Emperor sought cool weather, the court moved to the Great Bright Palace.

sentences.zh: 七月乙未，焚錦繡珠玉于前殿。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day yiwei brocade, embroidery, pearls, and jade were burned in the front hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on yiwei brocade, embroidery, pearls, and jade were burned in the front hall.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，禁采珠玉及為刻鏤器玩、珠繩帖縚服者，廢織錦坊。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu the gathering of pearls and jade, the making of carved trinkets and playthings, pearl-string pasted silks, and the weaving-brocade workshop were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu pearl-gathering and jade-gathering, carved trinkets and playthings, pearl-string pasted silks, and the weaving-brocade workshop were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 庚子，薛訥及奚、契丹戰于灤河，敗績。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi Xue Ne fought the Xi and Khitan on the Luan River and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Xue Ne fought the Xi and Khitan on the Luan River and suffered defeat.

sentences.zh: 丁未，襄王重茂薨，追冊為皇帝。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei Prince Xiang Chongmao died and was posthumously enregistered as emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Prince Xiang Chongmao died and was posthumously enregistered as emperor.

sentences.zh: 八月壬戌，禁女樂。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day renxu female musicians were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on renxu female musicians were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，吐蕃寇邊，薛訥攝左羽林軍將軍，為隴右防禦大使，右驍衛將軍郭知運為副，以伐之。

translations.literal: On the day yihai Tibet raided the frontier; Xue Ne acted as general of the Left Forest of Plumes Army and frontier defense commissioner of Longyou, with Guo Zhiyun, general of the Right Martial Cavalry Guard, as deputy, to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Tibet raided the frontier; Xue Ne acted as general of the Left Forest of Plumes Army and Longyou frontier defense commissioner, with Guo Zhiyun, general of the Right Martial Cavalry Guard, as deputy, to attack them.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅，作興慶宮。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day gengyin the Palace of Flourishing Celebration was built.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on gengyin the Palace of Flourishing Celebration was built.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，宴京師侍老于含元殿庭，賜九十以上几、杖，八十以上鳩杖，婦人亦如之，賜於其家。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou the court feasted the elderly attendants of the capital in the courtyard of Hanyuan Hall, granting tables and staffs to those over ninety and dove staffs to those over eighty, and to women likewise, with gifts sent to their homes.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the court feasted the capital's elderly attendants in the courtyard of Hanyuan Hall, granting tables and staffs to those over ninety and dove staffs to those over eighty, and to women likewise, with gifts sent to their homes.

sentences.zh: 戊申，幸溫湯。

translations.literal: On the day wushen the emperor visited the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the emperor visited the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 十月戊午，至自溫湯。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day wuwu he returned from the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on wuwu he returned from the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 甲子，薛訥及吐蕃戰于武階，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi Xue Ne fought Tibet at Wujie and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Xue Ne fought Tibet at Wujie and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙丑，封子嗣真為鄫王，嗣初鄂王，嗣玄鄄王。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day yichou the emperor's sons Sizhen, Sichu, and Sixuan were enfeoffed as Princes of Zeng, E, and Yan respectively.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on yichou the emperor's sons Sizhen, Sichu, and Sixuan were enfeoffed as Princes of Zeng, E, and Yan.

sentences.zh: 三年正月丁亥，立郢王嗣謙為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year on the day dinghai Prince Ying Siqian was established as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year on dinghai Prince Ying Siqian was established as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 降死罪，流以下原之。

translations.literal: Death sentences were commuted and those exiled or below were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Death sentences were commuted and those exiled or below were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 賜酺三日。

translations.literal: Three days of communal drinking were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Three days of communal feasting were granted.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，盧懷慎檢校黃門監。

translations.literal: On the day guimao Lu Huaishen was made acting Yellow Gate Supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Lu Huaishen was appointed acting Yellow Gate Supervisor.

sentences.zh: 二月辛酉，赦囚非惡逆、造偽者。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day xinyou prisoners were pardoned except for those guilty of great treason or forging.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on xinyou prisoners were pardoned except for those guilty of great treason or forging.

sentences.zh: 四月庚申，突厥部三姓葛邏祿來附。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day gengshen the three surnames of the Geluolu Turks of the Tiele came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on gengshen the three surnames of the Geluolu Turks of the Tiele came to submit.

sentences.zh: 右羽林軍大將軍薛訥為涼州鎮軍大總管，涼州都督楊執一副之；

translations.literal: Xue Ne, grand general of the Right Forest of Plumes Army, was made grand commander of the Liangzhou frontier army, with Yang Zhi, military governor of Liangzhou, as deputy;
translations.idiomatic: Xue Ne, grand general of the Right Forest of Plumes Army, was appointed grand commander of the Liangzhou frontier army, with Yang Zhi, military governor of Liangzhou, as deputy;

sentences.zh: 右衛大將軍郭虔瓘為朔州鎮軍大總管，并州長史王晙副之：以備突厥。

translations.literal: Guo Qianjin, grand general of the Right Guard, was made grand commander of the Shuofang frontier army, with Wang Jun, chief administrator of Bingzhou, as deputy: to guard against the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Qianjin, grand general of the Right Guard, was appointed grand commander of the Shuofang frontier army, with Wang Jun, chief administrator of Bingzhou, as deputy, to guard against the Turks.

sentences.zh: 五月丁未，以旱錄京師囚。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day dingwei, because of drought, prisoners of the capital were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on dingwei, because of drought, prisoners of the capital were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 戊申，避正殿，減膳。

translations.literal: On the day wushen the emperor avoided the main hall and reduced meals.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the emperor avoided the main hall and reduced court meals.

sentences.zh: 七月庚辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day gengchen of the seventh month there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the seventh month, gengchen, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 十月辛酉，巂州蠻寇邊，右驍衛將軍李玄道伐之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day xinyou the Xi barbarians raided the frontier; Li Xuandao, general of the Right Martial Cavalry Guard, attacked them.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on xinyou the Xi barbarians raided the frontier; Li Xuandao, general of the Right Martial Cavalry Guard, attacked them.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，薛訥為朔方道行軍大總管，太僕卿呂延祚、靈州刺史杜賔客副之。

translations.literal: On the day renxu Xue Ne was made mobile grand commander of the Shuofang circuit; Lü Yanzuo, minister of the palace stud, and Du Binke, prefect of Lingzhou, were deputies.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Xue Ne was appointed mobile grand commander on the Shuofang circuit; Lü Yanzuo, minister of the palace stud, and Du Binke, prefect of Lingzhou, served as deputies.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，如郿，赦所過徒罪以下，賜侍老九十以上及篤疾者物。

translations.literal: On the day guihai the emperor went to Mei; those guilty of exile and below along the route were pardoned, and those attending the elderly over ninety and the gravely ill were given goods.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the emperor went to Mei; those guilty of exile and below along the route were pardoned, and those attending the elderly over ninety and the gravely ill were given goods.

sentences.zh: 甲子，如鳳泉湯。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi the emperor went to Fengquan Hot Spring.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the emperor went to Fengquan Hot Spring.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，降大理繫囚罪。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen crimes of prisoners in the Court of Judicial Review were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen crimes of prisoners in the Court of Judicial Review were reduced.

sentences.zh: 十一月己卯，至自鳳泉湯。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day jimao he returned from Fengquan Hot Spring.
