translations.idiomatic: That winter brought no snow.

sentences.zh: 十年正月丁巳，如東都。

translations.literal: In the first month of the tenth year on the day dingsi the emperor went to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the tenth year on dingsi the emperor went to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，次望春頓，賜從官帛。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day dingchou he halted at Wangchun Station and granted silk to attending officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on dingchou he halted at Wangchun Station and granted silk to attending officials.

sentences.zh: 四月己亥，張說持節朔方軍節度大使。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day jihai Zhang Yue was commissioned with a staff of authority as frontier commissioner of the Shuofang Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on jihai Zhang Yue was commissioned with a staff of authority as frontier commissioner of the Shuofang Army.

sentences.zh: 五月戊午，突厥請和。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day wuwu the Turks requested peace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on wuwu the Turks requested peace.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，伊、汝水溢。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou the Yi and Ru rivers overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the Yi and Ru rivers overflowed.

sentences.zh: 閏月壬申，張說巡邊。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month on the day renshen Zhang Yue toured the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month on renshen Zhang Yue toured the frontier.

sentences.zh: 六月丁巳，河決博、棣二州。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day dingsi the Yellow River burst its banks in Bo and Di circuits.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on dingsi the Yellow River burst its banks in Bo and Di circuits.

sentences.zh: 七月庚辰，給復遭水州。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day gengchen circuits struck by flood were given tax relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on gengchen circuits struck by flood were given tax relief.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，安南人梅叔鸞反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu Mei Shuqing of Annan rebelled and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Mei Shuqing of Annan rebelled and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 九月，張說敗康願子于木盤山，執之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Zhang Yue defeated Kang Yuanzi at Mount Mupan and captured him.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Zhang Yue defeated Kang Yuanzi at Mount Mupan and captured him.

sentences.zh: 己卯，京兆人權梁山反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day jimao Quan Liangshan of the capital rebelled and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Quan Liangshan of the capital rebelled and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 癸未，吐蕃攻小勃律，北庭節度使張孝嵩敗之。

translations.literal: On the day guimao Tibet attacked Little Bolü; Zhang Xiaosong, commissioner of the Beiting circuit, defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Tibet attacked Little Bolü; Zhang Xiaosong, commissioner of the Beiting circuit, defeated them.

sentences.zh: 十月甲寅，如興泰宮，獵于上宜川。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day jiayin the emperor went to the Palace of Flourishing Felicity and hunted on Shangyi River.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on jiayin the emperor went to the Palace of Flourishing Felicity and hunted on Shangyi River.

sentences.zh: 庚申，如東都。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen the emperor went to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the emperor went to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 十二月，突厥請和。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the Turks requested peace.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the Turks requested peace.

sentences.zh: 十一年

translations.literal: The eleventh year
translations.idiomatic: The eleventh year

sentences.zh: 十一年正月丁卯，降東都囚罪，杖以下原之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eleventh year on the day dingmao crimes of prisoners in the Eastern Capital were reduced; those punished by beating and below were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eleventh year on dingmao crimes of prisoners in the Eastern Capital were reduced; those punished by beating and below were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 己巳，如并州，降囚罪，徒以下原之。

translations.literal: On the day jisi the emperor went to Bingzhou; crimes of prisoners were reduced and those on penal labor and below were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the emperor went to Bingzhou; crimes of prisoners were reduced and those on penal labor and below were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 賜侍老物。

translations.literal: Goods were granted to those attending the elderly.
translations.idiomatic: Goods were granted to those attending the elderly.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，次潞州，赦囚，給復五年，以故第為飛龍宮。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen he halted at Luzhou; prisoners were pardoned and tax relief was given for five years; his former residence was made the Palace of Flying Dragon.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he halted at Luzhou; prisoners were pardoned and tax relief was given for five years; his former residence was made the Palace of Flying Dragon.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，次并州，改并州為北都。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao he halted at Bingzhou and Bingzhou was renamed the Northern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he halted at Bingzhou and Bingzhou was renamed the Northern Capital.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，赦太原府，給復一年，下戶三年，元從家五年。

translations.literal: On the day guisi Taiyuan Prefecture was pardoned; tax relief was given for one year, lower households for three years, and households of original followers for five years.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Taiyuan Prefecture was pardoned; tax relief was given for one year, lower households for three years, and households of original followers for five years.

sentences.zh: 版授侍老八十以上上縣令，婦人縣君；

translations.literal: Those attending the elderly eighty and above were appointed by patent as magistrates of upper counties, and their wives as county ladies;
translations.idiomatic: Those attending the elderly eighty and above were granted patents as magistrates of upper counties, and their wives as county ladies;

sentences.zh: 九十以上上州長史，婦人郡君；

translations.literal: ninety and above as chief administrators of upper prefectures, and their wives as commandery ladies;
translations.idiomatic: ninety and above as chief administrators of upper prefectures, and their wives as commandery ladies;

sentences.zh: 百歲以上上州刺史，婦人郡夫人。

translations.literal: one hundred and above as prefects of upper prefectures, and their wives as commandery madames.
translations.idiomatic: one hundred and above as prefects of upper prefectures, and their wives as commandery madames.

sentences.zh: 二月己酉，貶張嘉貞為豳州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day jiyou Zhang Jiazhen was demoted to prefect of Binzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on jiyou Zhang Jiazhen was demoted to prefect of Binzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬子，如汾陰，祠后土，賜文武官階、勳、爵、帛。

translations.literal: On the day renzi the emperor went to Fenyin and sacrificed to the earth at Houtu; civil and military officials were granted ranks, merit orders, noble titles, and silk.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the emperor went to Fenyin and sacrificed to the earth at Houtu; civil and military officials were granted ranks, merit honors, titles, and silk.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，張說兼中書令。

translations.literal: On the day guihai Zhang Yue was additionally made secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Zhang Yue was additionally appointed secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未，至自汾陰，免所過今歲稅，赦京城。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day xinwei he returned from Fenyin; this year's tax along the route was remitted and the capital was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on xinwei he returned from Fenyin; this year's tax along the route was remitted and the capital was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 四月甲子，張說為中書令。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day jiazi Zhang Yue was made secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on jiazi Zhang Yue was appointed secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 吏部尚書王晙為兵部尚書、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Wang Jun, minister of the civil service, was made minister of war and jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jun, minister of the civil service, was appointed minister of war and jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 五月乙丑，復中宗于太廟。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day yichou Zhongzong was restored in the imperial temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on yichou Zhongzong was restored in the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 己丑，王晙持節朔方軍節度大使。

translations.literal: On the day jichou Wang Jun was commissioned with a staff of authority as frontier commissioner of the Shuofang Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Wang Jun was commissioned with a staff of authority as frontier commissioner of the Shuofang Army.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，遣使分巡天下。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao envoys were dispatched to tour and inspect all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao envoys were dispatched to tour and inspect the realm.

sentences.zh: 六月，王晙巡邊。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Wang Jun toured the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Wang Jun toured the frontier.

sentences.zh: 八月戊申，追號宣皇帝曰獻祖，光皇帝曰懿祖。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day wushen the Proclamation Emperor was posthumously titled Imperial Ancestor and the Luminous Emperor Imperial Exalted Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on wushen the Proclamation Emperor was posthumously titled Imperial Ancestor and the Luminous Emperor Imperial Exalted Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 十月丁酉，幸溫湯，作溫泉宮。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day dingyou the emperor visited the hot springs and built the Hot Spring Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on dingyou the emperor visited the hot springs and built the Hot Spring Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，至自溫湯。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin he returned from the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he returned from the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊寅，有事于南郊，大赦。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day wuyin the southern suburb rites were performed and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on wuyin the southern suburb rites were performed and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 賜奉祠官階、勳、爵，親王公主一子官，高年粟帛，孝子順孫終身勿事。

translations.literal: Officials attending the sacrifice were granted ranks, merit orders, and noble titles; imperial sons and princesses were granted one son an office; the aged were granted grain and silk; filial sons, dutiful grandsons, and chaste wives were exempted from labor for life.
translations.idiomatic: Officials attending the sacrifice were granted ranks, merit honors, and titles; imperial sons and princesses were granted one son an office; the aged were granted grain and silk; filial sons, dutiful grandsons, and chaste wives were exempted from labor for life.

sentences.zh: 天下酺三日，京城五日。

translations.literal: All under Heaven were granted three days of communal drinking; the capital five days.
translations.idiomatic: The realm was granted three days of communal feasting; the capital five days.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲午，如鳳泉湯。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day jiawu the emperor went to Fengquan Hot Spring.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on jiawu the emperor went to Fengquan Hot Spring.

sentences.zh: 戊申，至自鳳泉湯。

translations.literal: On the day wushen he returned from Fengquan Hot Spring.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he returned from Fengquan Hot Spring.

sentences.zh: 庚申，貶王晙為蘄州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen Wang Jun was demoted to prefect of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Wang Jun was demoted to prefect of Qi.

sentences.zh: 十二年

translations.literal: The twelfth year
translations.idiomatic: The twelfth year

sentences.zh: 十二年四月壬寅，詔傍繼國王禮當廢而屬近者封郡王。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the twelfth year on the day renyin an edict declared that collateral heirs to kingdoms whose ritual should be abolished but who were near in kinship should be enfeoffed as commandery princes.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the twelfth year on renyin an edict declared that collateral heirs to kingdoms whose ritual should be abolished but who were near in kinship should be enfeoffed as commandery princes.

sentences.zh: 七月己卯，廢皇后王氏為庶人。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day jimao Empress Wang was deposed and reduced to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on jimao Empress Wang was deposed and reduced to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 十月，庶人王氏卒。

translations.literal: In the tenth month the commoner Wang died.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the deposed Empress Wang died.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚午，如東都。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day gengwu the emperor went to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on gengwu the emperor went to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，溪州首領覃行章反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen Qin Xingzhang, chieftain of Xi Prefecture, rebelled and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Qin Xingzhang, chieftain of Xi Prefecture, rebelled and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，申王撝薨。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi Prince Shen Hui died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Prince Shen Hui died.

sentences.zh: 閏十二月丙辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day bingchen of the intercalary twelfth month there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the intercalary twelfth month, bingchen, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 十三年

translations.literal: The thirteenth year
translations.idiomatic: The thirteenth year

sentences.zh: 十三年正月戊子，降死罪，流以下原之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the thirteenth year on the day wuzi death sentences were commuted and those exiled and below were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the thirteenth year on wuzi death sentences were commuted and those exiled and below were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 遣使宣慰天下。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched to comfort all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to comfort the realm.

sentences.zh: 壬子，葬朔方隴右河西戰亡者。

translations.literal: On the day renzi those who died in battle on the Shuofang, Longyou, and Hexi frontiers were buried.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi those who died in battle on the Shuofang, Longyou, and Hexi frontiers were buried.

sentences.zh: 三月甲午，徙封郯王潭為慶王，陝王浚忠王，鄫王洽棣王，鄄王滉榮王。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day jiawu Prince Tan was transferred to Prince of Qing; Prince Jun to Prince of Zhong; Prince Qia to Prince of Di; Prince Huang to Prince of Rong.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on jiawu Prince Tan was transferred to Prince of Qing; Prince Jun to Prince of Zhong; Prince Qia to Prince of Di; and Prince Huang to Prince of Rong.

sentences.zh: 封子涺為光王，濰儀王，澐潁王，澤永王，清壽王，洄延王，沐盛王，溢濟王。

translations.literal: The emperor's sons Ti, Wei, Yun, Ze, Qing, Yan, Mu, Yi, and Yi were enfeoffed as Princes of Guang, Yi, Ying, Yong, Shou, Yan, Sheng, Ji, and Ji respectively.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's sons Ti, Wei, Yun, Ze, Qing, Yan, Mu, Yi, and Yi were enfeoffed as Princes of Guang, Yi, Ying, Yong, Shou, Yan, Sheng, Ji, and Ji.

sentences.zh: 九月丙戌，罷奏祥瑞。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day bingxu presentation of auspicious omens was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on bingxu presentation of auspicious omens was abolished.

sentences.zh: 十月辛酉，如兗州。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day xinyou the emperor went to Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on xinyou the emperor went to Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚午，次濮州，賜河南、北五百里內父老帛。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu he halted at Puzhou and granted silk to elders within five hundred li of Henan north and south.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he halted at Puzhou and granted silk to elders within five hundred li of north and south Henan.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚寅，封于泰山。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin he performed the feng sacrifice on Mount Tai.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he performed the feng sacrifice on Mount Tai.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，禪于社首。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao he performed the shan sacrifice at Sheshou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he performed the shan sacrifice at Sheshou.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day renchen a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 賜文武官階、勳、爵，致仕官一季祿，公主、嗣王、郡縣主一子官，諸蕃酋長來會者一官。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials were granted ranks, merit orders, and noble titles; retired officials one season's salary; imperial sons, successor princes, and commandery and county princesses one son an office; chieftains of various barbarians who came to the assembly one office each.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials were granted ranks, merit honors, and titles; retired officials one season's salary; imperial sons, successor princes, and commandery and county princesses one son an office each; chieftains of various barbarians who came to the assembly one office each.

sentences.zh: 免所過一歲、兗州二歲租。

translations.literal: One year's tax along the route was remitted and two years' tax for Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: One year's tax along the route was remitted and two years' tax for Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 賜天下酺七日。

translations.literal: All under Heaven were granted seven days of communal drinking.
translations.idiomatic: The realm was granted seven days of communal feasting.

sentences.zh: 丙申，幸孔子宅，遣使以太牢祭其墓，給復近墓五戶。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen the emperor visited Confucius's residence and dispatched an envoy to offer the great sacrifice at his tomb; five households near the tomb were given tax relief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen the emperor visited Confucius's residence and dispatched an envoy to offer the great sacrifice at his tomb; five households near the tomb were given tax relief.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，賜徐、曹、亳、許、仙、豫六州父老帛。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou silk was granted to elders of Xu, Cao, Bo, Xu, Xian, and Yu circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou silk was granted to elders of Xu, Cao, Bo, Xu, Xian, and Yu circuits.

sentences.zh: 十二月己巳，如東都。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day jisi the emperor went to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on jisi the emperor went to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 十四年

translations.literal: The fourteenth year
translations.idiomatic: The fourteenth year

sentences.zh: 十四年二月，邕州獠梁大海反，伏誅。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fourteenth year the Liao barbarians of Yongzhou, Liang Dahai, rebelled and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fourteenth year the Liao barbarians of Yongzhou, Liang Dahai, rebelled and were put to death.

sentences.zh: 四月丁巳，戶部侍郎李元紘為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day dingsi Li Yuanhong, vice minister of revenue, was made vice secretary of the secretariat and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on dingsi Li Yuanhong, vice minister of revenue, was appointed vice secretary of the secretariat and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 庚申，張說罷。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen Zhang Yue was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Zhang Yue was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，岐王範薨。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao Prince Qi Fan died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Prince Qi Fan died.

sentences.zh: 六月戊午，東都大風拔木。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day wuwu a great wind in the Eastern Capital uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on wuwu a great wind in the Eastern Capital uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔州縣長官言事。

translations.literal: On the day renxu an edict ordered prefectural and county chiefs to speak on affairs of government.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu an edict ordered prefectural and county chiefs to speak on affairs of government.

sentences.zh: 七月癸未，瀍水溢。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day guiwei the Chan River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on guiwei the Chan River overflowed.

sentences.zh: 八月丙午，河決魏州。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day bingwu the Yellow River burst its banks in Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on bingwu the Yellow River burst its banks in Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 九月己丑，磧西節度使杜暹檢校黃門侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day jichou Du Xian, commissioner of the Western Frontier circuit, was made acting vice director of the Yellow Gate and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on jichou Du Xian, commissioner of the Western Frontier circuit, was appointed acting vice director of the Yellow Gate and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十月甲寅，太白晝見。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day jiayin the Metal Star was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on jiayin Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 庚申，如廣成湯。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen the emperor went to Guangcheng Hot Spring.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the emperor went to Guangcheng Hot Spring.

sentences.zh: 己巳，如東都。

translations.literal: On the day jisi the emperor went to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the emperor went to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳，獵于方秀川。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day dingsi he hunted on Fangxiu River.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on dingsi he hunted on Fangxiu River.

sentences.zh: 十五年

translations.literal: The fifteenth year
translations.idiomatic: The fifteenth year

sentences.zh: 十五年正月辛丑，河西、隴右節度使王君ß及吐蕃戰于青海，敗之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifteenth year on the day xinchou Wang Junji, commissioner of the Hexi and Longyou circuits, fought the Tibetans at Qinghai and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifteenth year on xinchou Wang Junji, commissioner of the Hexi and Longyou circuits, fought the Tibetans at Qinghai and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 七月甲戌，震興教門觀，災。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day jiaxu the Gate of Flourishing Teaching Abbey was struck by thunder and burned.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on jiaxu the Gate of Flourishing Teaching Abbey was struck by thunder and burned.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，洛水溢。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin the Luo River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the Luo River overflowed.

sentences.zh: 己亥，降都城囚罪，徒以下原之。

translations.literal: On the day jihai crimes of prisoners in the capital were reduced; those on penal labor and below were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai crimes of prisoners in the capital were reduced; those on penal labor and below were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 八月，澗、穀溢，毀澠池縣。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the Jian and Gu rivers overflowed and destroyed Mianchi County.

translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he returned from Huaqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 九原郡太守郭子儀為朔方軍節度副大使，右羽林軍大將軍王承業為太原尹，衛尉卿張介然為河南節度採訪使，右金吾大將軍程千里為上黨郡長史，以討安祿山。

translations.literal: Guo Ziyi, prefect of Jiuyuan commandery, was made deputy commissioner of the Shuofang Army; Wang Chengye, grand general of the Right Forest of Plumes Army, was made chief magistrate of Taiyuan; Zhang Jieren, minister of the court of imperial stud, was made Henan frontier commissioner; Cheng Qianli was made chief administrator of Shangdang commandery—all to attack An Lushan.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Ziyi, prefect of Jiuyuan commandery, was appointed deputy commissioner of the Shuofang Army; Wang Chengye, grand general of the Right Forest of Plumes Army, was appointed chief magistrate of Taiyuan; Zhang Jieren, minister of the court of imperial stud, was appointed Henan frontier commissioner; and Cheng Qianli was appointed chief administrator of Shangdang commandery—all to attack An Lushan.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，榮王琬為東討元帥，高仙芝副之。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou Prince Rong Wan was made eastern expedition commander-in-chief with Gao Xianzhi as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Prince Rong Wan was made eastern expedition commander-in-chief with Gao Xianzhi as deputy.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁亥，安祿山陷靈昌郡。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day dinghai An Lushan captured Lingchang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on dinghai An Lushan captured Lingchang commandery.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，陷陳留郡，執太守郭納，張介然死之。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao he captured Chenliu commandery, seized Prefect Guo Na, and Zhang Jieren died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he captured Chenliu commandery, seized Prefect Guo Na, and Zhang Jieren was killed.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，安祿山陷滎陽郡，太守崔無詖死之。

translations.literal: On the day guisi An Lushan captured Xingyang commandery and Prefect Cui Wubi died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi An Lushan captured Xingyang commandery and Prefect Cui Wubi was killed.

sentences.zh: 丙申，封常清及安祿山戰于甖子谷，敗績。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen Feng Changqing fought An Lushan at Yingzigu and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Feng Changqing fought An Lushan at Yingzigu and suffered defeat.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，陷東京，留守李憕、御史中丞盧弈、判官蔣清死之。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou he captured the Eastern Capital; the acting prefect Li Qian, Censor-in-Chief Lu Yi, and aide Jiang Qing died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he captured the Eastern Capital; the acting prefect Li Qian, Censor-in-Chief Lu Yi, and aide Jiang Qing were killed.

sentences.zh: 河南尹達奚珣叛降于安祿山。

translations.literal: Daxi Xun, chief magistrate of Henan, rebelled and surrendered to An Lushan.
translations.idiomatic: Daxi Xun, chief magistrate of Henan, rebelled and surrendered to An Lushan.

sentences.zh: 己亥，恒山郡太守顏杲卿敗何千年，執之，克趙、鉅鹿、廣平、清河、河間、景城、樂安、博平、博陵、上谷、文安、信都、魏、鄴十四郡。

translations.literal: On the day jihai Yan Gaoqing, prefect of Hengshan commandery, defeated He Qiannian and captured him, recovering fourteen commanderies: Zhao, Julu, Guangping, Qinghe, Hejian, Jingcheng, Le'an, Boping, Boling, Shanggu, Wen'an, Xindu, Wei, and Ye.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Yan Gaoqing, prefect of Hengshan commandery, defeated He Qiannian and captured him, recovering fourteen commanderies including Zhao, Julu, Guangping, Qinghe, Hejian, Jingcheng, Le'an, Boping, Boling, Shanggu, Wen'an, Xindu, Wei, and Ye.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，封常清、高仙芝伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day guimao Feng Changqing and Gao Xianzhi were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Feng Changqing and Gao Xianzhi were put to death.

sentences.zh: 哥舒翰持節統領處置太子先鋒兵馬副元帥，守潼關。

translations.literal: Geshu Han was commissioned with a staff of authority as deputy commander-in-chief disposing of the crown prince's vanguard forces and guarded Tong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Geshu Han was commissioned with a staff of authority as deputy commander-in-chief disposing of the crown prince's vanguard forces and guarded Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，郭子儀及安祿山將高秀巖戰于河曲，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen Guo Ziyi fought Gao Xiuyan, general of An Lushan, on the River Bend and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Guo Ziyi fought Gao Xiuyan, general of An Lushan, on the River Bend and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 戊申，榮王琬薨。

translations.literal: On the day wushen Prince Rong Wan died.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Prince Rong Wan died.

sentences.zh: 壬子，濟南郡太守李隨、單父尉賈賁、濮陽人尚衡以兵討安祿山。

translations.literal: That month Li Sui, prefect of Jinan commandery; Jia Ben, captain of Shanfu; and Shang Heng of Puyang raised troops to attack An Lushan.
translations.idiomatic: That month Li Sui, prefect of Jinan commandery; Jia Ben, captain of Shanfu; and Shang Heng of Puyang raised troops to attack An Lushan.

sentences.zh: 是月，平原郡太守顏真卿、饒陽郡太守盧全誠、司馬李正以兵討安祿山。

translations.literal: That month Yan Zhenqing, prefect of Pingyuan commandery; Lu Quancheng, prefect of Raoyang commandery; and Li Zheng, military commissioner, raised troops to attack An Lushan.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yan Zhenqing, prefect of Pingyuan commandery; Lu Quancheng, prefect of Raoyang commandery; and Li Zheng, military commissioner, raised troops to attack An Lushan.

sentences.zh: 十五載

translations.literal: The fifteenth year
translations.idiomatic: The fifteenth year

sentences.zh: 十五載正月乙卯，東平郡太守嗣吳王祗以兵討安祿山。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifteenth year on the day yimao Li Zhi, heir to Prince Wu of the Eastern Capital, raised troops to attack An Lushan.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifteenth year on yimao Li Zhi, heir to Prince Wu of the Eastern Capital, raised troops to attack An Lushan.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，李隨為河南節度使，以討祿山。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen Li Sui was made Henan commissioner to attack Lushan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Li Sui was made Henan commissioner to attack Lushan.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，祿山陷恒山郡，執顏杲卿、袁履謙，陷鄴、廣平、鉅鹿、趙、上谷、博陵、文安、魏、信都九郡。

translations.literal: On the day renxu Lushan captured Hengshan commandery, seized Yan Gaoqing and Yuan Lüqian, and captured nine commanderies: Ye, Guangping, Julu, Zhao, Shanggu, Boling, Wen'an, Wei, and Xindu.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Lushan captured Hengshan commandery, seized Yan Gaoqing and Yuan Lüqian, and captured nine commanderies: Ye, Guangping, Julu, Zhao, Shanggu, Boling, Wen'an, Wei, and Xindu.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，朔方軍節度副使李光弼為河東節度副大使，以討祿山。

translations.literal: On the day guihai Li Guangbi, deputy commissioner of the Shuofang Army, was made deputy commissioner of the Hedong circuit to attack Lushan.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Li Guangbi, deputy commissioner of the Shuofang Army, was appointed deputy commissioner of the Hedong circuit to attack Lushan.

sentences.zh: 甲子，南陽郡太守魯炅為南陽節度使，率嶺南、黔中、山南東道兵屯于葉縣。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi Lu Hui, prefect of Nanyang commandery, was made Nanyang commissioner and led troops of Lingnan, Qianzhong, and the eastern mountain circuit to camp at Yexian.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Lu Hui, prefect of Nanyang commandery, was appointed Nanyang commissioner and led troops of Lingnan, Qianzhong, and the eastern mountain circuit to camp at Yexian.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，安慶緒寇潼關，哥舒翰敗之。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou An Qingxu raided Tong Pass and Geshu Han defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou An Qingxu raided Tong Pass and Geshu Han defeated him.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，真源令張巡以兵討安祿山。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou Zhang Xun of Zhenyuan county raised troops to attack An Lushan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Zhang Xun of Zhenyuan county raised troops to attack An Lushan.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，嗣吳王祗及祿山將謝元同戰于陳留，敗之。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day jihai Li Zhi fought Xie Yuantong, general of Lushan, at Chenliu and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on jihai Li Zhi fought Xie Yuantong, general of Lushan, at Chenliu and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 李光弼克常山郡，郭子儀出井陘會光弼，及安祿山將史思明戰，敗之。

translations.literal: Li Guangbi captured Changshan commandery; Guo Ziyi came out through Jingxing to join Guangbi and fought Shi Siming, general of An Lushan, and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guangbi captured Changshan commandery; Guo Ziyi came out through Jingxing to join Guangbi and fought Shi Siming, general of An Lushan, and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 庚子，賈賁戰于雍丘，死之。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi Jia Ben fought at Yongqiu and died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Jia Ben fought at Yongqiu and was killed.

sentences.zh: 三月，顏真卿克魏郡。

translations.literal: In the third month Yan Zhenqing captured Wei commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Yan Zhenqing captured Wei commandery.

sentences.zh: 史思明寇饒陽、平原。

translations.literal: Shi Siming raided Raoyang and Pingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Siming raided Raoyang and Pingyuan.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，張巡及安祿山將令狐潮戰于雍丘，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day yimao Zhang Xun fought Linghu Chao, general of An Lushan, at Yongqiu and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Zhang Xun fought Linghu Chao, general of An Lushan, at Yongqiu and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，殺戶部尚書安思順、太僕卿安元貞。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen Minister of Revenue An Sishun and Minister of the Palace Stud An Yuanzhen were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Minister of Revenue An Sishun and Minister of the Palace Stud An Yuanzhen were killed.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，李光弼克趙郡。

translations.literal: On the day yichou Li Guangbi captured Zhao commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Li Guangbi captured Zhao commandery.

sentences.zh: 四月乙酉，北海郡太守賀蘭進明以兵救平原。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day yiyou Helan Jinming, prefect of Beihai commandery, led troops to relieve Pingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on yiyou Helan Jinming, prefect of Beihai commandery, led troops to relieve Pingyuan.

sentences.zh: 丙午，太子左贊善大夫來瑱為潁川郡太守、兼招討使。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu Lai Tian, senior mentor of the crown prince, was made prefect of Yingchuan commandery and additionally pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Lai Tian, senior mentor of the crown prince, was appointed prefect of Yingchuan commandery and additionally pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 五月丁巳，魯炅及安祿山戰于滍水，敗績，奔于南陽。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day dingsi Lu Hui fought An Lushan at the Zhi River, was defeated, and fled to Nanyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on dingsi Lu Hui fought An Lushan at the Zhi River, suffered defeat, and fled to Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，嗣虢王巨為河南節度使。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen Li Ju, heir to Prince of Guo, was made Henan commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Li Ju, heir to Prince of Guo, was appointed Henan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 六月癸未，顏真卿及安祿山將袁知泰戰于堂邑，敗之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day guiwei Yan Zhenqing fought Yuan Zhitai, general of An Lushan, at Tangyi and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on guiwei Yan Zhenqing fought Yuan Zhitai, general of An Lushan, at Tangyi and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 賀蘭進明克信都。

translations.literal: Helan Jinming captured Xindu.
translations.idiomatic: Helan Jinming captured Xindu.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，哥舒翰及安祿山戰于靈寶西原，敗績。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu Geshu Han fought An Lushan on the western plain of Lingbao and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Geshu Han fought An Lushan on the western plain of Lingbao and suffered defeat.

sentences.zh: 是日，郭子儀、李光弼及史思明戰于嘉山，敗之。

translations.literal: That day Guo Ziyi and Li Guangbi fought Shi Siming at Jia Mountain and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: That day Guo Ziyi and Li Guangbi fought Shi Siming at Jia Mountain and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，蕃將火拔歸仁執哥舒翰叛降于安祿山，遂陷潼關、上洛郡。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao the barbarian general Huoba Guiren seized Geshu Han, rebelled, and surrendered to An Lushan; Tong Pass and Shangluo commandery were then lost.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the barbarian general Huoba Guiren seized Geshu Han, rebelled, and surrendered to An Lushan; Tong Pass and Shangluo commandery were then lost.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔親征。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu an edict ordered the emperor to campaign in person.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu an edict ordered the emperor to campaign in person.

sentences.zh: 京兆尹崔光遠為西京留守、招討處置使。

translations.literal: Cui Guangyuan, chief magistrate of the capital, was made western capital acting prefect and pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Guangyuan, chief magistrate of the capital, was appointed western capital acting prefect and pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙申，行在望賢宮。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen the mobile court was at Wangxian Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen the mobile court was at Wangxian Palace.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，次馬嵬，左龍武大將軍陳玄禮殺楊國忠及御史大夫魏方進、太常卿楊暄。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou the court halted at Mawei; Chen Xuanli, grand general of the Left Dragon Martial Army, killed Yang Guozhong, Supervising Censor Wei Fangjin, and Minister of Ceremonies Yang Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the court halted at Mawei; Chen Xuanli, grand general of the Left Dragon Martial Army, killed Yang Guozhong, Supervising Censor Wei Fangjin, and Minister of Ceremonies Yang Xuan.

sentences.zh: 賜貴妃楊氏死。

translations.literal: Imperial Consort Yang was ordered to die.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Consort Yang was ordered to die.

sentences.zh: 是日，張巡及安祿山將翟伯玉戰于白沙堝，敗之。

translations.literal: That day Zhang Xun fought Zhai Boyu, general of An Lushan, at Baisha Dike and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: That day Zhang Xun fought Zhai Boyu, general of An Lushan, at Baisha Dike and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 己亥，祿山陷京師。

translations.literal: On the day jihai Lushan captured the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Lushan captured the capital.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，次陳倉。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou the court halted at Chencang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the court halted at Chencang.

sentences.zh: 閑廄使任沙門叛降于祿山。

translations.literal: Ren Shamen, commissioner of the separate stud, rebelled and surrendered to Lushan.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Shamen, commissioner of the separate stud, rebelled and surrendered to Lushan.

sentences.zh: 丙午，次河池郡。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu the court halted at Hechi commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the court halted at Hechi commandery.

sentences.zh: 劍南節度使崔圓為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Cui Yuan, commissioner of the Jiannan circuit, was made vice secretary of the secretariat and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yuan, commissioner of the Jiannan circuit, was appointed vice secretary of the secretariat and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 七月甲子，次普安郡。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day jiazi the court halted at Pu'an commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on jiazi the court halted at Pu'an commandery.

sentences.zh: 憲部侍郎房琯為文部尚書、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Fang Guan, vice minister of the bureau of punishments, was made minister of the civil service bureau and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Guan, vice minister of the bureau of punishments, was appointed minister of the civil service bureau and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，皇太子為天下兵馬元帥，都統朔方、河東、河北、平盧節度使，御史中丞裴冕、隴西郡司馬劉秩副之。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao the crown prince was made commander-in-chief of all armies under Heaven, supreme over the Shuofang, Hedong, Hebei, and Pinglu commissioners; Pei Mian, censor-in-chief, and Liu Zhi, military commissioner of Longxi commandery, were deputies.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the crown prince was made commander-in-chief of all armies under Heaven, supreme over the Shuofang, Hedong, Hebei, and Pinglu commissioners; Pei Mian, censor-in-chief, and Liu Zhi, military commissioner of Longxi commandery, served as deputies.

sentences.zh: 江陵大都督永王璘為山南東路黔中江南西路節度使，盛王琦為廣陵郡都督、江南東路淮南道節度使，豐王珙為武威郡都督、河西隴右安西北庭節度使。

translations.literal: Prince Lin of Yong was made commissioner of the southeastern mountain, Qianzhong, and Jiangnan western circuits; Prince Qi of Sheng was made military governor of Guangling commandery and commissioner of the Jiangnan eastern and Huainan circuits; Prince Gong of Feng was made military governor of Wuwei commandery and commissioner of the Hexi, Longyou, Andong, and Beiting circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Lin of Yong was made commissioner of the southeastern mountain, Qianzhong, and Jiangnan western circuits; Prince Qi of Sheng was made military governor of Guangling commandery and commissioner of the Jiangnan eastern and Huainan circuits; and Prince Gong of Feng was made military governor of Wuwei commandery and commissioner of the Hexi, Longyou, Andong, and Beiting circuits.

sentences.zh: 庚午，次巴西郡。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu the court halted at Baxi commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the court halted at Baxi commandery.

sentences.zh: 以太守崔渙為門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事，韋見素為左相。

translations.literal: Cui Huan, prefect of Taizhou, was made vice director of the Chancellery and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery; Wei Jiansu was made Left Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Huan, prefect of Taizhou, was appointed vice director of the Chancellery and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery; Wei Jiansu was appointed Left Minister.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，次蜀郡。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen the court halted at Shu commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the court halted at Shu commandery.

sentences.zh: 八月壬午，大赦，賜文武官階、爵，為安祿山脅從能自歸者原之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day renwu a general amnesty was proclaimed; civil and military officials were granted ranks and noble titles; those coerced by An Lushan who could return of themselves were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on renwu a general amnesty was proclaimed; civil and military officials were granted ranks and titles; those coerced by An Lushan who could return of themselves were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，皇太子即皇帝位于靈武，以聞。

translations.literal: On the day guisi the crown prince ascended the imperial throne at Lingwu and the news was reported.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the crown prince ascended the imperial throne at Lingwu and the news was reported.

sentences.zh: 庚子，上皇天帝誥遣韋見素、房琯、崔渙奉皇帝冊于靈武。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi the Retired Emperor of Heaven issued a proclamation dispatching Wei Jiansu, Fang Guan, and Cui Huan to present the imperial register to the emperor at Lingwu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the Retired Emperor of Heaven issued a proclamation dispatching Wei Jiansu, Fang Guan, and Cui Huan to present the imperial register to the emperor at Lingwu.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲寅，憲部尚書李麟同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day jiayin Li Lin, minister of the bureau of punishments, was made Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on jiayin Li Lin, minister of the bureau of punishments, was appointed Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲辰，永王璘反，廢為庶人。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day jiachen Prince Lin of Yong rebelled and was deposed as a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on jiachen Prince Lin of Yong rebelled and was deposed as a commoner.

sentences.zh: 至德二載

translations.literal: The second year of Zhide
translations.idiomatic: The second year of Zhide

sentences.zh: 至德二載正月庚戌，誥求天下孝悌可旌者。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year of Zhide on the day gengxu a proclamation sought filial and fraternal persons worthy of honor throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year of Zhide on gengxu a proclamation sought filial and fraternal persons worthy of honor throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 甲子，劍南健兒賈秀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi Jia Xiu of Jiannan brave guards rebelled and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Jia Xiu of Jiannan brave guards rebelled and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 三月庚午，通化郡言玄元皇帝降。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day gengwu Tonghua commandery reported that the Mysterious Origin Emperor descended.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on gengwu Tonghua commandery reported that the Mysterious Origin Emperor descended.

sentences.zh: 五月庚申，誥追冊貴嬪楊氏為皇后。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day gengshen a proclamation posthumously enregistered Noble Consort Yang as empress.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on gengshen a proclamation posthumously enregistered Noble Consort Yang as empress.

sentences.zh: 七月庚戌，行營健兒李季反，伏誅。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day gengxu Li Ji of the mobile camp brave guards rebelled and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on gengxu Li Ji of the mobile camp brave guards rebelled and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 庚午，劍南健兒郭千仞反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu Guo Qianren of Jiannan brave guards rebelled and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Guo Qianren of Jiannan brave guards rebelled and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 十月丁巳，皇帝復京師，以聞。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day dingsi the emperor recovered the capital and the news was reported.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on dingsi the emperor recovered the capital and the news was reported.

sentences.zh: 誥降劍南囚罪，流以下原之。

translations.literal: A proclamation commuted crimes of prisoners in Jiannan; those exiled and below were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: A proclamation commuted crimes of prisoners in Jiannan; those exiled and below were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁未，至自蜀郡，居于興慶宮。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day dingwei he returned from Shu commandery and dwelt in the Palace of Flourishing Celebration.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on dingwei he returned from Shu commandery and dwelt in the Palace of Flourishing Celebration.

sentences.zh: 三載，上號曰太上至道聖皇天帝。

translations.literal: In the third year he was given the title Retired Emperor of Heaven Supreme Dao Sage Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was given the title Retired Emperor of Heaven Supreme Dao Sage Emperor.

sentences.zh: 上元元年

translations.literal: The first year of Shangyuan
translations.idiomatic: The first year of Shangyuan

sentences.zh: 上元元年，徙居于西內甘露殿。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shangyuan he moved to dwell in the Sweet Dew Hall of the Western Inner Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shangyuan he moved to dwell in the Sweet Dew Hall of the Western Inner Palace.

sentences.zh: 元年建巳月，崩于神龍殿，年七十八。

translations.literal: In the first month jiansi of the first year he died in the Hall of Divine Dragon at age seventy-eight.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month jiansi of the first year he died in the Hall of Divine Dragon at age seventy-eight.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：睿宗因其子之功，而在位不久，固無可稱者。

translations.literal: The appraisal says: Ruizong, relying on his son's achievement, held the throne only briefly and indeed had little to commend.
translations.idiomatic: The appraisal says: Ruizong, relying on his son's achievement, held the throne only briefly and had little to commend.

sentences.zh: 嗚呼，女子之禍於人者甚矣！

translations.literal: Alas, the harm women do to men is very great!
translations.idiomatic: Alas, the harm women do to men is very great!

sentences.zh: 自高祖至于中宗，數十年間，再罹女禍，唐祚旣絕而復續，中宗不免其身，韋氏遂以滅族。

translations.literal: From Gaozu down to Zhongzong, within several decades calamity from women struck twice; though Tang's mandate was cut off and then restored, Zhongzong could not preserve himself and the Wei clan was thus destroyed to the last.
translations.idiomatic: From Gaozu down to Zhongzong, within several decades calamity from women struck twice; though the Tang mandate was cut off and then restored, Zhongzong could not save himself and the Wei clan was destroyed to the last.

sentences.zh: 玄宗親平其亂，可以鑒矣，而又敗以女子。

translations.literal: Xuanzong personally quelled that disorder—it should have been a warning—yet he was ruined again by a woman.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong personally quelled that disorder—it should have been a warning—yet he was ruined again by a woman.

sentences.zh: 方其勵精政事，開元之際，幾致太平，何其盛也！

translations.literal: When he applied himself to government at the beginning of Kaiyuan, he nearly brought the age to great peace—how flourishing it was!
translations.idiomatic: When he applied himself to government at the beginning of Kaiyuan, he nearly brought the age to great peace—how flourishing it was!

sentences.zh: 及侈心一動，窮天下之欲不足為其樂，而溺其所甚愛，忘其所可戒，至於竄身失國而不悔。

translations.literal: Once his extravagant heart stirred, the desires of all under Heaven were insufficient for his pleasure; he drowned in what he loved excessively and forgot what he should have guarded, until he fled and lost the state without regret.
translations.idiomatic: Once his extravagant heart stirred, the desires of all under Heaven were insufficient for his pleasure; he drowned in what he loved excessively and forgot what he should have guarded, until he fled and lost the state without regret.

sentences.zh: 考其始終之異，其性習之相遠也至於如此。

translations.literal: Considering how far apart his beginning and end were, how remote the habits of his nature were, it came to this.
translations.idiomatic: Considering how far apart his beginning and end were, how remote the habits of his nature were, it came to this.

sentences.zh: 可不慎哉！

translations.literal: How careful one must be!
translations.idiomatic: How careful one must be!

sentences.zh: 可不慎哉！

translations.literal: How careful one must be!
translations.idiomatic: How careful one must be!
